881996b806ced46b.description:
Who Should Apply

 

We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit:

  • Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design.

  • Full-Stack & Web Developers working with modern front-end or back-end frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, etc.).

  • Backend & Systems Developers experienced in languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust, or Python.

  • DevOps & Database Engineers familiar with API design, SQL/NoSQL databases, or scripting.

 

Role & Responsibilities

As an AI Code Trainer, you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains.

  • Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices.

  • Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts.

  • Test Design: Build unit tests and edge-case scenarios to evaluate model accuracy and expose edge-case failures.

  • Technical Feedback: Write structured explanations detailing why an AI solution succeeds, fails, or produces bugs.

 

Requirements

  • Software Engineering Proficiency: Strong core fundamentals in at least one major programming language or web stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, C#, Rust, PHP).

  • Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency.

  • Technical Communication: Clear written English to explain technical concepts and code review rationales effectively.

  • Eligible Locations: Resident of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, or Philippines.

 

Why Join Us?

  • $50–$125/hr commensurate with your technical domain expertise and task complexity.

  • Weekly Guaranteed Payouts directly to your choice

Leverage Live Local prepares and manages Florida Live Local Act property tax exemptions for multifamily owners. We represent more than 90 properties and about 30,000 units. Demand is not our constraint. Operations is. This seat owns the operating system that lets us grow without breaking.

What's in it for you. A base of 180,000 dollars with upside tied to the numbers you own, full compensation likely 250,000 to 350,000 dollars when the role is performing. Direct weekly access to the founder. Twenty days of paid time off plus federal holidays. Fully remote.

What you own

  • Every exemption application submitted correctly and on time, every cycle
  • Decision tracking by the statutory deadline, logged in the system of record

This is for you if you have walked into a messy, growing services business and made it run tight, you like being measured on real numbers, and you have managed a team of three or more. You must be able to work core hours overlapping 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern US time.

This is not for you if you have never owned operations for a multi million dollar service business, you would rather build strategy decks than run a daily operating rhythm, or you want a strict nine to five.

Compensation and benefits

  • Performance upside tied to the five scorecard numbers
  • Direct weekly founder access
  • 20 days PTO plus US federal holidays
  • 500 dollars per month health stipend
  • 1,000 dollar home office stipend
  • 1,200 dollars per year professional development

How to apply. Answer these screening questions in your application note: what metrics did you track in your last role and what were they when you started versus when you left; how many people have you directly managed (minimum 3); have you owned a process with hard regulatory or external deadlines; can you work core hours that overlap 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern; does a base salary of 180,000 dollars work for you. About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude
